landing.title: Welcome to ClinicQueue
landing.subtitle: Book appointments and track your place in the clinic queue.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use your email or phone and password.
auth.registerSubtitle: One account works across clinics you join.
auth.chooseClinicSubtitle: You belong to more than one clinic. Pick which one to open.
auth.clinicNotFoundSubtitle: This registration link is invalid or the clinic is unavailable.
auth.clinicLoadErrorSubtitle: Check your connection and try again, or find your clinic another way.
auth.clinicEntrySubtitle: {{specialty}} — register or sign in to continue.
auth.clinicEntryCta: Create an account or sign in to join this clinic.
auth.forbiddenSubtitle: You do not have permission to open this page for the current clinic.
auth.forbiddenHelp: Switch to a clinic where you have access, go to your home screen, or sign out.
auth.findClinicSubtitle: Your account is ready. Join a clinic by entering its code or scanning the clinic QR code.
auth.findClinicHelp: You need the clinic’s public code (slug) or the QR posted at reception. This is not a dead end — pick one path below.
auth.findClinicSlugRequired: Enter a clinic code to continue.
auth.findClinicQrTitle: Prefer to scan a QR code?
auth.findClinicQrGuidance: Ask reception for the clinic QR code. Opening that link takes you to the clinic’s join page.
auth.findClinicStep1: Ask reception for the printed QR or clinic code.
auth.findClinicStep2: Scan the QR with your phone camera, or type the code above.
auth.findClinicStep3: Register or sign in on that clinic’s page to join.

patientQueue.title: Your place in line
patientQueue.subtitle: Your queue number updates live. We show how many patients are ahead — never a time estimate.
patientQueue.bookFailed: Booking did not go through. Please try again.
patientQueue.emptyTitle: No visit in the queue yet
patientQueue.empty: Book below to get a temporary number and track your place live.
patientQueue.error: Check your connection and try again. Your place is safe if you already booked.

instruction.pending: Waiting for your place in line

instructionDetail.waitHome: Relax — you still have time before you need to leave.
instructionDetail.headToClinic: Make your way to the clinic. Keep this screen open.
instructionDetail.yourTurn: Please go to the reception desk now.
instructionDetail.paused: Your place is saved. We'll continue from here when the clinic resumes.

reception.title: Reception queue console
reception.subtitle: Confirm arrivals, call next, book on behalf, and insert urgent cases.
reception.loadError: Could not load today's queue. Try refreshing.
reception.reasonAuditHint: A reason is mandatory and is written to the audit log (FR-031). Submit is blocked until you provide one.
reception.reasonRequiredError: Enter a reason before inserting. This is required for the audit log.
reception.emergencyPauseHint: Separated on purpose — pause freezes the live queue for every waiting patient. Confirmation is required.
reception.pauseReasonRequired: Enter a pause reason before continuing.
reception.resumeHint: Authorized for doctor or clinic owner (FR-052).
reception.noSession: No open session for today yet.
reception.pausedBannerBody: Arrivals and calls are frozen. Positions are preserved.
reception.pausedUseBanner: Use Resume in the banner above when it is safe to continue.
reception.confirmAbsentBody: Mark {{patient}} as absent and advance the queue? This cannot be undone from this screen.
reception.confirmInstantBody: Instant entry inserts the patient into the live queue immediately and records your reason in the audit log.
reception.confirmPauseBody: All waiting patients will be notified. Positions stay unchanged until a doctor or owner resumes.
reception.confirmRestrictBody: Block {{patient}} from booking new appointments after repeated absences? An owner can lift this later.

patientBookings.title: Manage your bookings
patientBookings.subtitle: Book a visit, track temporary numbers, and manage dependents — your real queue number comes at arrival.
patientBookings.error: Check your connection and try again.
patientBookings.cancelConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will lose this temporary number.
patientBookings.fr022Title: Your real queue number is assigned when you arrive
patientBookings.fr022Body: Booking gives you a temporary number only. Reception confirms you at the clinic and then assigns your real place in line — by arrival order. Do not expect a fixed position at booking time.
patientBookings.fr022Short: Temporary number now · real number only after reception confirms your arrival.
patientBookings.bookSuccess: Booked with temporary #{{number}}. Your real number comes when reception confirms you.
patientBookings.typeUrgentHint: Urgent is advisory at booking. Reception confirms the final type.
patientBookings.depositProofHint: Upload a clear photo of the transfer receipt.
patientBookings.depositProofRequired: Upload a deposit screenshot to continue.
patientBookings.depositProofFailed: Could not read that file. Try another image.
patientBookings.dependentsHint: Register a family member once, then book on their behalf.
patientBookings.urgentHint: Urgent is advisory at booking. Reception confirms the final type.
patientBookings.depositProofPlaceholder: https://… or paste a link to your transfer screenshot
patientBookings.loadError: Could not load bookings. Check your connection and try again.

doctor.title: Doctor console
doctor.subtitle: Today's overview, emergency pause, queue call-next, and fast visit entry.
doctor.readOnlyBanner: Clinic owner view — clinical content is read-only.
doctor.emergencyHint: Use this when you must leave — waiting patients are notified and positions stay frozen.
doctor.loadError: Could not load today's queue. Try refreshing.
doctor.noSession: No queue session for today yet.
doctor.pauseReasonRequired: Enter a pause reason before continuing.
doctor.pausedBannerBody: The queue is frozen. Positions are preserved until you resume.
doctor.pausedUseBanner: Use Resume in the banner above when it is safe to continue.
doctor.visitHint: Keyboard-friendly entry between patients — diagnosis first, then optional notes and prescription.
doctor.noVisitYet: No visit recorded for this appointment yet.
doctor.confirmPauseBody: Waiting patients will be notified. Reason: {{reason}}

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.subtitle: Activate or suspend clinics, manage subscriptions, review analytics, and export clinic data.
admin.analyticsSubtitle: Usage and revenue across all clinics.
admin.suspendedReadOnlyNote: READ-ONLY — data is preserved; writes are blocked (not deleted).
admin.confirmSuspendBody: The clinic becomes READ-ONLY. Existing data is kept. Staff cannot write new records until you activate again. This does not delete the clinic.
admin.handoffBody: Share this onboarding link with the clinic so patients can join via the /r/ clinic path.
admin.handoffQrHint: Print or encode this path as a QR for the clinic door / reception desk.
admin.handoffUnavailable: Onboarding link is not available for this clinic from the admin session.
admin.handoffFallback: Ask the clinic owner for their /r/… link from clinic signup, or open the clinic QR endpoint while scoped to that clinic.

ownerSettings.title: Clinic settings
ownerSettings.subtitle: Queue rules, branding, and the patient QR / join link.
ownerSettings.opsHint: These control how patients are told to wait at home vs head in, urgent interleave, and absence handling.
ownerSettings.urgentRatioHint: Default 2 means two present normals, then one present urgent.
ownerSettings.headToClinicThresholdHint: At or below this count, patients see “Head to the clinic”.
ownerSettings.brandingHint: Shown on the clinic QR entry page so patients know they joined the right place.
ownerSettings.qrHint: Print or share this link at reception. Patients open it to register into this clinic.
ownerSettings.qrLinkOnly: No QR image stored yet — share the join link above.
ownerSettings.qrUnavailable: Join link is not available for this clinic.

ownerReports.title: Clinic reports & staff
ownerReports.subtitle: Volume, absence, peak hours, deposit revenue, and receptionist accounts.
ownerReports.loadError: Could not load reports for this range.
ownerReports.emptyHistory: Not enough history yet. Keep running clinic days, then reopen this range.
ownerReports.emptyRevenue: No confirmed deposits in this range yet.
ownerReports.insightVolume: Busiest point in range: {{date}} with {{count}} appointments.
ownerReports.insightAbsenceHigh: Absence rate is {{rate}}% — consider tightening reminders or deposit rules.
ownerReports.insightAbsenceOk: Absence rate is {{rate}}% for this range.
ownerReports.insightPeakDay: {{day}} is your busiest day in this range.
ownerReports.insightPeakHour: {{hour}} UTC is your busiest hour in this range.
ownerReports.insightRevenue: {{count}} confirmed deposits collected in this range.
ownerReports.staffHint: Invite receptionists and revoke access when someone leaves (FR-015).
ownerReports.confirmRevokeBody: Revoke access for {{name}}? They will no longer reach the reception console.

receptionDayclose.title: Day close & deposits
receptionDayclose.subtitle: Review today's outcomes, confirm deposits, then close the day irreversibly.
receptionDayclose.fr065Body: Patients who paid a deposit and did not arrive are moved to the next operating day at close — no manual step required.
receptionDayclose.noSession: No queue session for today yet.
receptionDayclose.confirmIrreversible: This action is irreversible. The session cannot be reopened.
receptionDayclose.confirmAutoCarry: {{count}} deposit no-show(s) will be carried over automatically.
receptionDayclose.confirmNotified: {{count}} patient(s) will be notified of the carry-over.
receptionDayclose.confirmRemaining: {{count}} unserved patient(s) will need a carry-over or cancel decision after close.
receptionDayclose.unservedHint: Choose carry over (recommended) or cancel for each remaining patient.
receptionDayclose.closeFirst: Close the day to load the unserved list.
receptionDayclose.closeFirstRefresh: Day is closed. Refresh if the unserved list does not appear.
receptionDayclose.carryDefaultHint: Carry over is the default — keeps their place for tomorrow.
receptionDayclose.cancelConfirmBody: The patient will not be carried to tomorrow.
receptionDayclose.error: Check your connection and try again.
receptionDayclose.summaryEmpty: No appointments recorded for today yet.
receptionDayclose.depositAutoCarryNote: Deposit-paid no-shows carry over automatically at close (FR-065) — no manual step required.
receptionDayclose.loadError: Could not load day-close data. Check your connection and try again.
receptionDayclose.confirmDecisionNeeded: {{count}} unserved patient(s) will need a carry-over or cancel decision after close.

patientMedical.title: Medical history
patientMedical.subtitle: A calm read-only view of your health profile, visits, and prescriptions at this clinic.
patientMedical.noMembership: You are not registered as a patient at this clinic yet.
patientMedical.loadError: Could not load your medical information. Try again.
patientMedical.emptyHistory: When you complete a visit, your diagnosis, notes, and prescriptions will appear here.
patientMedical.readOnlyNote: This screen is read-only. Ask your clinic to update your profile if something is missing.
